transport_hand_assumptions.packet_headers_ACK_cwnd_recovery: excluded from this application-level hand oracle; real network must determine actual delivery later
transport_hand_assumptions.scope: two directional nonpreemptive FIFO byte servers, not the shared radio engine

policy.retry_trigger: failure-notice-0 message delivered to client AND retry_count<1
policy.capture_version: read client current version only when retry capture starts
policy.server_rejection: after old nonpreemptive task completes compare captured version with latest actual delivered client version notification
policy.client_action_commit: only if action.attempt is active and action.version equals local version at receipt; otherwise locally reject
policy.deduplication: attempt token and notice ID consumed once; duplicate delivery cannot create another retry
policy.retry_exhaustion: terminal failure after attempt1 rejection; no implicit attempt2

message_templates.ready_event: server task0 end with stale version
client capture1 end after actual failure-notice-0 delivery
server task1 end with matching delivered version

tasks.scope: capture/PNG work unmodeled; do not report zero total compute

operator_fixture.identity: tiny declared matrix-work fixture, not a real VL model and not inferred from PNG bytes
operator_fixture.excluded: PNG decode, preprocessing, real vision encoder, full attention/MLP, nonmatmul operators; plug separately verified VL operator ledger into task work_ref before any real-model claim
